from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Optional

# Import models from existing modules to avoid circular imports
from database.database import Thumbnail, df_thumb as db_df_thumb, del_thumb as db_del_thumb, thumb as db_thumb
from database.db import custom_caption, update_cap as db_update_cap, del_caption as db_del_caption, get_caption as db_get_caption


class AbstractThumbnailRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for thumbnail data access."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save(self, user_id: int, msg_id: int) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[Thumbnail]:
        pass


class AbstractCaptionRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for caption data access."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save(self, user_id: int, caption: str) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[custom_caption]:
        pass


class ThumbnailRepository(AbstractThumbnailRepository):
    """Concrete implementation for thumbnail operations."""

    async def save(self, user_id: int, msg_id: int) -> None:
        await db_df_thumb(user_id, msg_id)

    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        await db_del_thumb(user_id)

    async def get(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[Thumbnail]:
        return await db_thumb(user_id)


class CaptionRepository(AbstractCaptionRepository):
    """Concrete implementation for caption operations."""

    async def save(self, user_id: int, caption: str) -> None:
        await db_update_cap(user_id, caption)

    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        await db_del_caption(user_id)

    async def get(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[custom_caption]:
        return await db_get_caption(user_id)


# Instantiate repositories as module-level singletons for easy injection
thumbnail_repo = ThumbnailRepository()
caption_repo = CaptionRepository()
